headline: Size‑up after losses is costing you

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Your size‑up after a loss cost ₹1,05,732. It occurred in 96 after‑loss trades where the median entry size rose to ₹12,562 versus your usual median of ₹6,578, a size ratio of 1.91x. Those trades resulted in a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a win rate of 28%, while other trades posted a win rate of 39%.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is worth watching as it may be affecting your results.

closing: Consider applying the rule about keeping your entry size steady after a loss for the next review period.
